name: National Fellowship Scheme For Higher Education of ST Students (National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students - Fellowship component)
provider: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India

rules.quote: Scholarship is provided to 750 fresh ST students every year each year for pursing M Phil and PhD selected on merit based on marks of Master Degree.
This is a Central Sector Scheme fully funded and implemented by Central Govt for pursuing MPhil and PhD in following:

value: deemed universities under s.3 UGC Act eligible for UGC grants
rules.quote: Universities/Institutions/Colleges included under section 2(f) /12(B) or 2(D) and 12(B) of UGC Act

rules.value: 750 fellowships per year; selection on merit of Master's degree marks
rules.quote: 750 fresh ST students every year each year for pursing M Phil and PhD selected on merit based on marks of Master Degree

rules.value: preference to girls, Divyangjan and PVTGs
rules.quote: Preference is given to girls, Divyangan and PVTGs.

amount.text: Rs 25,000 per month (MPhil), Rs 28,000 per month (PhD) plus contingency and HRA as per guidelines (page also mentions a revised rate w.e.f. 1.1.2023)
amount.quote: Fellowship for M.Phil is provided @ Rs. 25000/- per month and for Ph.D @ Rs.28000/- per month.

deadline.text: Applications for 2025-26 were invited and the deadline extended; no current date on the page
deadline.quote: Extension of deadline for application Submission - National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students (NFST) 2025-26
